name: agentic-platform
description: Installs a host-local agentic QA runtime into a target repository, discovers its surfaces, and runs multi-agent QA flows with Playwright.
author: Allan Bruno <allanbruno@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:unit: tsx packages/dashboard-api/src/ingestion/boundary.test.ts && npm run verify:domain-discovery-contracts && npm run verify:static-frontend-scanner && npm run verify:domain-fixture-matrix && npm run verify:domain-specialist-service
scripts.test:runtime: cd templates/persona-qa-dashboard/packages/api && npx vitest run && node --import tsx --test src/routes/__tests__/*.test.ts && cd ../web && npx vitest run
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cd templates/persona-qa-dashboard/packages/api && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc -b
